bio: A 10-seat counter is the stage for this multi-course sushi experience, where each element is introduced and explained to diners by the light-hearted and engaging team. Watch the chefs' deft hands at work as they craft dishes founded on superlative, mostly Norwegian ingredients. The skilful preparations include traditional nigiri as well as more playful, internationally tinged creations like a fish ‘taco’ where nori replaces the usual tortilla....
